A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same WPT research and contain complete, readable main text and supplementary Sections 6–7. Text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original WPT evaluations on nuScenes and Bench2Drive, reward and distillation ablations, and appendix multi-ability and computational results.

after.justification: v2 reports the same original WPT experiments in Tables 1–9, together with qualitative closed-loop demonstrations in Figure 7.

M1.justification: The world-model-assisted teacher, lightweight student, imitation and simulation rewards, and policy/reward distillation remain unchanged. Section 3 and appendix Sections 6.1–6.3 retain the same procedures and architectures.

E1.justification: Both versions use nuScenes and Bench2Drive with the same open-loop and closed-loop tasks. The appendix retains the same five driving-ability categories and six qualitative scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1, 2, and 7, including Drive-OccWorld on nuScenes and DriveTransformer and DriveDPO on Bench2Drive. Citation renumbering does not change the evaluated methods.

E3.justification: Both retain the nuScenes 700/150/150 split, Bench2Drive 950 training and 50 validation clips, and 220 evaluation routes. Metrics, training schedules, batch sizes, and appendix computational comparisons are unchanged.

E4.justification: Tables 3–6 retain the same reward-usage, reward-component, occupancy-source, and distillation ablations. Appendix computational analyses and Figure 7 case studies provide the same evidence.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for the experiments. Statistical reporting remains unchanged.

E6.justification: Experimental values and result entries in Tables 1–9 are unchanged. For example, WPT-Teacher retains 0.61 m average L2 and 0.11% collision on nuScenes and a 79.23 Bench2Drive driving score; qualitative findings are also retained.

T1.justification: Equations 1–16 and the appendix reward definitions in Equations 17–23 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: Both claim online world-to-policy transfer through trainable rewards and two distillation mechanisms, strong open-loop and closed-loop performance, and up to 4.9× faster student inference. The shortened conclusion preserves these contributions.

C2.justification: Sections 4.3–4.4 retain the same explanations of reward benefits, world-model supervision, and knowledge transfer. The efficiency–comfort tradeoff and proposed future reward-shaping refinements are unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 and the appendix preserve implementation details, optimizer and training settings, reward thresholds, and compute/latency information. No code or data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: v2 adds WorldLens and 4D Driving Scene Generation with Stereo Forcing citations and a vision-language-action survey bibliography entry. Section 2.2 removes individual summaries of several retained references, including DriveDreamer, Vista, GaussianAD, and World4Drive, without changing WPT's central positioning.

P1.justification: v2 corrects grammar, standardizes terminology, condenses related work and the conclusion, updates bibliography entries, and adds funding acknowledgements. Numbered appendix pointers become generic references; the overall section structure remains intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is slightly resized, table captions and spacing receive small adjustments, and text reflows across pages. All seven figures and nine tables are retained, with no substantive diagram or table-structure changes.

improvement.justification: v2 provides modest copyediting and bibliographic cleanup while preserving the method, experimental evidence, and reproducibility information. The more concise prose offers small readability benefits, while generic appendix pointers reduce navigational precision. These limited editorial effects leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
